verdict.rationale: Smithery runs an MCP server registry that developers can search and connect to via the CLI. It lists named third-party servers such as Exa, Context7 and Browserbase, and an independent scan of its 'top 100 servers' shows the catalog is at least that large. However, the shutdown notice says the proxied connection layer (API, Connect, Toolbox, CLI and SDKs) stopped working on October 31, 2026, leaving only a non-proxied registry, so integrations are no longer reachable through the platform. Missing for 10: a documented catalog size in the hundreds-to-thousands range, and a working platform-mediated way to reach integrations after the shutdown.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
